articles.title: Operation Frozen Recovery: Alaska Soldiers Retrieve Historic Signal Corps Radio
articles.summary: Nine Soldiers assigned to Headquarters and Headquarters Detachment, 59th Signal Battalion, recovered a historic U.S. Army Signal Corps radio from the wreckage of a U.S. Air Force TB-29 bomber in Alaska, Aug. 10-11, 2026. The radio had remained at the crash site since 1957, when the aircraft went down during a training mission.
